test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A contractor agreed to complete a job in 74 days. He employed 21 men to work, but only one-fourth of the work was completed in 32 days. How many additional men must he employ to finish the remaining work within the stipulated time?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the MDH formula: (M₁ × D₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) ÷ W₂

⇒ (21 × 32) ÷ (1/4) = (M₂ × 42) ÷ (3/4)

⇒ 21 × 32 × 3 = M₂ × 42

⇒ M₂ = (21 × 32 × 3) ÷ 42 = 48 men

⇒ Additional men needed = 48 − 21 = 27 men

**∴ The correct answer is 27 men.**
